items.exampleEn: Scientists discovered the first vitamin more than a hundred years ago.
items.exampleZh: 科學家在一百多年前發現了第一種維他命。

items.exampleEn: She bought a pack of gum at the station before her long train ride.
items.exampleZh: 她在搭長途火車前，先在車站買了一包口香糖。

items.exampleEn: The baby dropped her teaspoon on the floor and laughed.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶把小湯匙掉到地上，然後咯咯笑。

items.exampleEn: Some birds hide nuts in the ground to eat in winter.
items.exampleZh: 有些鳥會把堅果藏在土裡，留到冬天吃。

items.exampleEn: My neighbor grows herbs in small pots on her balcony.
items.exampleZh: 我鄰居在陽台的小盆子裡種香草。

items.exampleEn: Golden fields of wheat stretched as far as we could see.
items.exampleZh: 金黃色的麥田一望無際。

items.exampleEn: The puppy chewed my new shoes while I was at work.
items.exampleZh: 我去上班時，小狗把我的新鞋咬壞了。

items.exampleEn: The restaurant is famous for its spicy crab.
items.exampleZh: 那家餐廳以辣味螃蟹聞名。

items.sentenceEn: This bread is made from whole wheat and a little honey.
items.sentenceZh: 這種麵包是用全麥和一點蜂蜜做的。

items.audioEn: Add one teaspoon of salt to the water before you put in the pasta.
items.audioZh: 放義大利麵之前，先在水裡加一茶匙鹽。
items.questionZh: 放義大利麵之前要做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Fresh herbs make any simple dish taste better.
items.sentenceZh: 新鮮香草能讓任何簡單的菜變得更好吃。

items.sentenceEn: We caught three small crabs at the beach and then let them go.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在海邊抓了三隻小螃蟹，然後把牠們放走了。

items.stemEn: This meat is tough, so you'll need to ____ it well.
items.stemZh: 這塊肉很韌，所以你得好好咀嚼。

items.stemEn: Some people can't eat this cake because it contains ____.
items.stemZh: 有些人不能吃這個蛋糕，因為裡面有堅果。

items.passageEn: Our cooking class this week was about a simple seaside meal. First, the teacher showed us how to clean fresh crab and cook it with garlic and a teaspoon of butter before serving it on a large tray. Then we made bread from wheat flour and chopped some herbs from the school garden to put on top. For dessert, we baked cookies with honey and nuts. The teacher explained that different foods contain different vitamins, so it's fun to cook with many colors. At the end, a student laughed because he had been chewing gum the whole class and forgot to taste anything!
items.passageZh: 這週的烹飪課主題是簡單的海邊料理。首先，老師示範怎麼清理新鮮螃蟹，再用大蒜和一茶匙奶油下去煮，最後盛在大托盤上。接著我們用小麥麵粉做麵包，並切了學校菜園的香草撒在上面。甜點是加了蜂蜜和堅果的餅乾。老師解釋說，不同的食物含有不同的維他命，所以用很多顏色的食材來做菜很有趣。下課時，有個學生笑了出來，因為他整堂課都在嚼口香糖，忘了嘗任何東西！

options: 他整堂課嚼口香糖忘了試吃

items.promptZh: 請把口香糖丟進垃圾桶，不要黏在桌子底下。
referenceEn: Please put your gum in the trash can, not under the desk.
Please throw your gum in the bin instead of sticking it under the table.
rubricZh: gum 指口香糖，不可數（例如 your gum）
「丟進」可寫 put… in、throw… in 等；「不要黏在」可寫 not under、instead of sticking it under 等

items.instructionZh: 用 herb 造一個句子，說說你喜歡或用過的香草。
referenceEn: I like to add fresh herbs to my eggs in the morning.
Mint is my favorite herb for summer drinks.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 herb 或 herbs（例如 fresh herbs）
